# --instructions--

编写一个函数 `countWords(words)`，返回一个 `Map`，其中每个键是数组 `words` 中的一个单词，值是该单词出现的次数

# --asserts--

`countWords` 必须返回一个 `Map`。

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["a"]) instanceof Map);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` 必须将 `"red"` 映射到 `3`。

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).get("red") === 3);
```

`countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"])` 必须有 `3` 个键值对。

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords(["red", "blue", "red", "green", "red"]).size === 3);
```

`countWords([])` 必须有 `0` 个键值对。

```javascript
tryCatch(countWords([]).size === 0);
```

# --solutions--

```javascript
function countWords(words) {
  let counts = new Map();
  for (const word of words) {
    if (counts.has(word)) {
      counts.set(word, counts.get(word) + 1);
    } else {
      counts.set(word, 1);
    }
  }
  return counts;
}
```
